scripts.build: sh -c 'cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install && npm run build'
scripts.dev:client: sh -c 'cd client && npm install && npm run dev'
scripts.dev:server: sh -c 'cd server && npm install && npm run dev'
scripts.lint: sh -c 'cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint'
scripts.lint:fix: sh -c 'cd server && npm run lint:fix && cd ../client && npm run lint:fix'
scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'cd server && npm run typecheck && cd ../client && npm run typecheck'
